title: How to Write a Message People Read

pre.en: What mistake did Chen make this morning?
pre.zh: 小陈今天早上自己犯了什么错？
options: He asked for something at the last minute.
He sent a message that he then had to take back.
He wrote to three people at once.
He forgot to add a screenshot.

intro: 小陈给新来的实习生做了一次简短的分享（幻灯片还禁着），讲工作消息怎么写才有人看。读的时候留意表示目的的说法：to save time、in order to stop …、so that people know … 都在回答「为什么要这么做」；也看看他每条建议几乎都用动词原形开头，直接告诉听的人该怎么做。

sentences.en: Right, I'm Chen, and I've got a few tips for you new interns.
sentences.zh: 好，我是小陈，给你们这些新来的实习生讲几条建议。

sentences.en: No slides — they're still banned.
sentences.zh: 没有幻灯片——现在还禁着呢。

sentences.en: So, our team sends hundreds of messages a day.
sentences.zh: 是这样，我们团队一天要发几百条消息。

sentences.en: Most of them are read in five seconds, or not at all.
sentences.zh: 大多数五秒钟就看完了，要么根本没人看。

sentences.en: Everything I'm going to tell you, I've learned the hard way.
sentences.zh: 下面要说的，全是我吃过亏才学到的。

sentences.en: First, get to the point in the first line.
sentences.zh: 第一，第一行就说重点。

sentences.en: Say what you need straight away, so that people know what to do.
sentences.zh: 一上来就说你要什么，好让大家知道该做什么。

sentences.en: Second, make it clear who should act.
sentences.zh: 第二，说清楚该谁来做。

sentences.en: If you're writing to three people, name the one who should reply.
sentences.zh: 如果同时发给三个人，就点名让其中一个回复。

sentences.en: I always do that in order to stop three people doing the same job.
sentences.zh: 我一直这么做，免得三个人去干同一件事。

sentences.en: Third, describe bugs step by step.
sentences.zh: 第三，一步一步地描述 bug。

sentences.en: Write down every step so that anyone can reproduce the problem.
sentences.zh: 把每一步都写下来，好让谁都能复现问题。

sentences.en: Add a screenshot to save time.
sentences.zh: 再加一张截图，省时间。

sentences.en: But you don't need to explain the whole history in detail.
sentences.zh: 不过来龙去脉不用写得那么细。

sentences.en: Fourth, think about the ending.
sentences.zh: 第四，想想怎么收尾。

sentences.en: It's a good idea to end with one simple question.
sentences.zh: 最好用一个简单的问题结尾。

sentences.en: That way, everyone's on the same page.
sentences.zh: 这样大家就不会各想各的了。

sentences.en: And don't ask for things at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 还有，别到最后一刻才找人要东西。

sentences.en: Ask in advance, and keep people posted when plans change.
sentences.zh: 提前问，计划有变就及时告诉大家。

sentences.en: Fifth, get a second opinion.
sentences.zh: 第五，请别人帮你把把关。

sentences.en: Before you send a long message, ask a colleague to look it over.
sentences.zh: 发长消息之前，请同事帮你看一遍。

sentences.en: If it sounds like a complaint, you'd better rewrite it.
sentences.zh: 要是读起来像在抱怨，最好重写。

sentences.en: If someone points out a mistake, thank them.
sentences.zh: 有人指出错误的话，记得谢谢人家。

sentences.en: Oh, by the way, "ASAP" is not a deadline.
sentences.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，「ASAP」可不是截止日期。

sentences.en: If you need something by Friday, say Friday.
sentences.zh: 周五要，就写周五。

sentences.en: Finally, double-check your message before you press Send.
sentences.zh: 最后，按「发送」之前再检查一遍。

sentences.en: Then you'll never have to write, "Please ignore my last message."
sentences.zh: 这样你就永远不用再发「请忽略我上一条消息」了。

sentences.en: Like I did this morning.
sentences.zh: 就像我今天早上那样。

cards.note: learn sth the hard way 是「吃了苦头才明白」；反过来是 the easy way。
to start talking or writing about the most important thing
cards.tip: 对别人说 Could you get to the point?（能说重点吗？），就算用了 could 也透着不耐烦，开会时要慎用；自己先说 Let me get to the point 就很自然。
cards.example: I'll get to the point: we need two more developers.

cards.note: to say or show something in a way that people cannot misunderstand
cards.tip: it 是形式宾语，真正的内容在后面：make it clear who / that / what …；也可以说 make sth clear。
cards.example: Please make it clear in the ticket which version you tested.

cards.note: doing one thing at a time, in a fixed order
cards.tip: 当副词放在动词后面；放在名词前要加连字符：a step-by-step guide。
cards.example: The guide explains the setup step by step.

cards.note: 开发里常说 reproduce a bug，口语缩写成 repro；平时也指「复制、繁殖」。
截图是 take a screenshot；口语里也直接当动词：screenshot the error。
to need less time to do something
including all the facts and small parts of something
cards.tip: detail 在这里不加 s，也不加冠词；「更详细地」说 in more detail。
cards.example: We'll discuss the design in detail on Thursday.

cards.note: used to give advice in a friendly way
cards.tip: 后面接动词原形；比 you should 委婉，像在给朋友出主意。否定说 It's not a good idea to …。
cards.example: It's a good idea to back up your work before the update.

cards.zh: 想法一致；（对情况）理解一致
cards.note: to understand a situation in the same way as other people
cards.tip: 开会常用：Are we on the same page?（大家理解一致吧？）不是「在同一页」的字面意思。
cards.example: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.

cards.note: at the latest possible time, just before something happens
before a particular time or event
to keep telling someone the latest news about something
原指「再找一位医生看看」；工作里指请另一个人再看一遍、给个意见。
to read or examine something quickly in order to check it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：look it over；要逐条细看，一般用 go through。
cards.example: Can you look over my slides before I send them?

cards.note: used to say what you think something is, from what you hear
cards.tip: 不只说耳朵听到的，读到的文字也能用：Your email sounds a bit angry.；like 后面接名词或句子。
cards.example: It sounds like the client wants a cheaper version.

cards.note: 动词是 complain；正式投诉是 make a complaint。
to tell someone something they did not know or had not noticed
cards.tip: 指出的东西放后面：point out a mistake；是代词就放中间：point it out。
cards.example: My manager pointed out two problems with the plan.

cards.note: used to add something, often on a different subject
to check something again to make sure it is correct
工作群里常见的一句「请忽略上一条」；ignore sb 是「不理某人」。
